candidates.finding: Private passport/upload-link mutations still enter through ordinary useMutation. A global/local onMutate await can precede initial API owner capture; current cache callbacks are also unbound. Existing GC/MCP regressions prove the general mechanism, not these exact hooks.
candidates.proof_next: Use actual hooks plus deferred global onMutate; invoke as A, replace actor or authority before release, assert no private write/cache continuation under B. Preserve successful same-authority renewal and public token lookup.
candidates.implementation_seam: Use existing usePrivateMutation and original requestConfig forwarding in private API methods, retaining public signatures/DTOs and public token methods.

candidates.finding: Mixed upload helpers/fields appear to retain family/name/contact-only pieces from the retired legacy happy path alongside reachable Fresh/returning helpers.
candidates.proof_next: Resolve every runtime/type/export edge with TS graph and inspect actual production callers; preserve safety tests by moving them to current owners before closed-set retirement.

candidates.finding: ReextractPassportControl treats submitted plus any feedback as processing; rejection feedback may keep the retry disabled after inFlight resets.
candidates.proof_next: Render submitted record, reject re-extraction and assert visible actionable retry and no duplicate in-flight dispatch.
candidates.resolution: Full needsReextraction/getReextractOutcome/current caller trace plus rendered tests show eligible failed starts can retry, while submitted means verification pending and must remain blocked. No speculative processing-policy change. See passport-group-presentation-reviewed-files.json.

candidates.finding: Controller uses render-captured membership/count before functional selection updates; same-turn repeated toggles may duplicate IDs or cross cap. Custom count parseInt may accept a decimal as its integer prefix.
candidates.proof_next: Exercise actual controller same-turn selection and cap, then decimal custom-count apply. Preserve server order, revision snapshots and cross-page manual selection.
candidates.resolution: Actual controller regressions proved duplicate same-turn toggles,1501 cap overflow and decimal-prefix acceptance; atomic IDs/revisions/Set state plus whole-count validation fixes all. Added separate cap-excluded revision-map accumulation proof/fix. See passport-group-controller-reviewed-files.json.

candidates.finding: Roster/mobile navigation nests Button in Link; absolute bulk disclosure may clip at narrow widths.
candidates.proof_next: Inspect rendered focus/DOM and 390px bounding boxes before changing; preserve routing, keyboard focus return and control surfaces.
candidates.resolution: Nested button/anchor proven in both mobile and desktop rows; fixed using buttonVariants on the sole anchor and preserved row isolation. Narrow bulk-disclosure bounds remains unproven/pending.

candidates.finding: Passport list and possibly group-link list mix query failure notices with empty/zero success presentation when initial data is unavailable.
candidates.proof_next: Render initial failure separately from successful empty and stale-data failure. Assert clear failure/retry with no false first-group/zero claim; preserve retained data on refetch failure.
candidates.resolution: All Groups initial/stale failure presentation reproduced and fixed, preserving true empty and selection. Group-link list failure/empty distinction remains pending its actual rendered proof.

candidates.finding: Clipboard completion in create dialog can schedule a copied-state timeout after unmount cleanup has already run.
candidates.proof_next: Defer clipboard, unmount, complete promise and inspect timers/state; do not claim a data leak from this alone.

candidates.finding: Replacement choices use role=radio buttons without an explicit roving tabindex/arrow-key selection implementation.
candidates.proof_next: Render several actual candidates and test radiogroup arrow/Home/End/Space keyboard behavior; retain details disclosure, stable request ID and selected-recipient evidence.
candidates.resolution: Actual recipient dialog ArrowDown failed to move focus/selection. Replaced role-radio buttons with native grouped radios, retaining callback/request-ID semantics; unit and Chromium1440/390 checks pass. Related browser proof caught clipped long unbroken names, now wrapped. See group-whatsapp-reviewed-files.json.
